parts.name: 45 Degree Supports
parts.description: 45 degree support made from 1501 profile, 6.000” long (C), used to reinforce 90 degree connections. It is premachined with counterbores and a 45 degree miter on both ends and comes with socket head cap screws, washers and T-nuts.
features: Used to reinforce 90 degree connections; premachined with counterbores and 45 degree miter angle on both ends
Includes socket head cap screws, washers and T-nuts
parts.dimension_notes: A and B = cross-section dimensions of the support profile (B is the width shown in the end view), C = overall length of the support measured tip to tip along the mitered ends, D = included hardware (bolt, T-nut, washer)
parts.notes: Included hardware (D): bolt 3112 x2, T-nut 3278 x2, washer 3260 x6. Product photo is representative only (length will vary). Built from 1501 profile. Washer qty of 6 (with 2 bolts) is as printed in the catalog row; the 1515-ULS versions list 2.
